We introduce FilmFlow, an agentic framework that converts natural-language instructions or reference videos into explicit camera trajectories for dynamic 3D environments. items.title: RIDAR: Safeguarding Research Integrity in Autonomous Research Agents via Automated Detection and Runtime Intervention
items.summary: Autonomous research agents are increasingly used to automate large portions of scientific research, yet they are prone to research integrity violations (RIVs): behaviors that compromise the validity, reproducibility, or faithfulness of the research process. We present RIDAR, a framework for automated RIV detection and runtime intervention. First, we introduce RIVT, a comprehensive taxonomy of 14 RIV types spanning the full research lifecycle. The problem of event sequence forecasting occurs in finance, healthcare, business process intelligence, and other fields. In this work, we study multi-horizon forecasting of event sequences as a conditional generative modeling problem. items.summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have shown strong promise for generalist robotic manipulation, but their inference cost remains a major bottleneck for real-time control. This limitation is especially pronounced in flow-matching VLAs such as π_{0.5}, where the action expert is evaluated repeatedly during iterative denoising. items.summary: Video scene graph generation (VidSGG) aims to capture objects and their evolving relationships in videos. This requires accounting for both the persistence of object identities and abrupt changes in relationships. items.title: WeVisOne-VL: Unified Visual Perception from Objects to Pixels
items.summary: Existing vision-language models (VLMs) remain unreliable for fine-grained visual perception. In this report, we present WeVisOne-VL (WeChat Vision All-in-One), a powerful VLM that unifies object-level and pixel-level perception through structured next-token prediction. items.summary: Fine-grained visual understanding requires distinguishing subtle differences in local attributes and spatial relations, yet remains challenging for existing vision-language models. Unified multimodal models (UMMs) offer a new opportunity through generation pathways that preserve rich visual information complementary to understanding. items.summary: Masked diffusion language models generate tokens in parallel, but their efficiency depends on which predictions are committed. items.summary: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (FF3DGS) reconstructs 3D scenes from images in a single forward pass, making it well-suited to applications that must operate within limited resource budgets. items.title: TILDE: Teacher-in-the-Loop Distillation from Embodied Foundation Models
items.summary: Large-scale action pretraining equips Embodied Foundation Models (EFMs) with strong manipulation capabilities, with particular strengths in generalization and closed-loop robustness, but reproducing such pretraining requires substantial robot data and computation. To transfer these capabilities from pretrained EFMs to policies without action pretraining, we introduce TILDE (Teacher-In-the-Loop Distillation from EFMs), which synergizes on-policy distillation at student-induced states with learning from teacher-executed recovery trajectories. items.title: RouteWeaver: Weaving Mode Selection and Execution into Unified LLM Routing
items.summary: LLM routing dynamically selects and coordinates heterogeneous language models across diverse tasks. However, existing approaches are largely built around a predefined execution paradigm, such as single-round, multi-round, or agentic routing, which fixes how model calls are organized and limits adaptation to different query needs. items.summary: Tool-using voice agents often leave users waiting after speech ends, even when actionable information arrives earlier in the request. Speculative approaches begin work during speech, but chunk-bounded or interrupt-on-update generation can truncate a tool call before its arguments are complete. items.summary: High-quality image editing requires precise modification of target regions while preserving the content of unrelated regions. Existing editing models produce flattened outputs that limit precise local manipulation and layer reuse, while decomposition methods typically optimize layer recovery separately from instruction-driven editing. items.summary: This paper studies category-level RGB-D object pose estimation, which recovers an object's 3D rotation and translation without instance-specific CAD models or reference views. items.summary: World Action Models (WAMs) have emerged as a promising approach to learning generalist robot policies using rich spatiotemporal priors from pre-trained video diffusion models. items.title: AnyGameRenderer: Entity-Consistent Generative Rendering Across Games and an Entity-Level Benchmark
items.summary: AI coding agents can now build small playable games in minutes, but the results usually look like programmer art: gray blockouts, colored geometric primitives, and flat semantic blobs. items.title: Toward Recursive Self-Improvement in Physical AI
items.summary: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) describes a system that improves not only its behavior but also the process by which it improves. Recent digital agents test this idea by rewriting their own code and checking each version with executable tests. items.title: MolLean: A Process-Verifiable Language for Chemical Reasoning
items.summary: Chemical chain-of-thought can contain hallucinated structural and property claims. We thereby introduce MolLean, a process-verifiable language that grounds chemical reasoning in an explicit molecular state. A layered Lean-based kernel checks state transitions and assertions over molecular readouts, from primitive graph edits to compound transformations. items.title: SEAM: Spectral Embedding Alignment and Merging for Low-Resource TTS
items.summary: Expanding the vocabulary of conditional text-to-speech (TTS) models typically requires extensive fine-tuning with paired audio, creating a major bottleneck for low-resource and cross-lingual adaptation. items.summary: Controllable 3D part generation is pivotal for digital asset creation, yet existing methods lack the flexibility to accommodate diverse user workflows requiring varying levels of control. In this paper, we introduce FlexPart, a unified image-to-3D part generation framework that supports variable-granularity geometric conditions within a single model. items.summary: Robotic foundation models are typically evaluated through costly closed-loop rollouts, which motivates cheap offline proxies for model capability. items.summary: We consider online monitoring of an AI system that produces a sequence of decisions. items.title: 为什么说奇瑞是一家AI公司？
items.summary: 奇瑞为什么是AI公司？它用AI重造了自己造车的方式，把这层能力做成可复用的底座，并让它长出了汽车之外的新物种。 作者 | 王瑞昊 编辑 | 李雨晨 “ 有几位领导跟我说，感觉奇瑞的汽车越来越不像汽车了，奇瑞也越来越不像一家车企了。这是我想听到的 —— 奇瑞就是一家「披着汽车企业马甲」的高科技创新企业。 ” 10 月 20 日， 2026 奇瑞全球创新大会在安徽芜湖开幕。说出这句话的，是做了四十多年汽车的奇瑞汽车董事长尹同跃。一个把大半辈子交给汽车的人，主动摘掉 “ 车企 ” 这块招牌，不是自谦，是判断。 他的依据是一个隐喻： 1886 年，奔驰造出第一台汽车，被时代抛下的，是那些一辈子赶马车的养马人，他们没做错什么，只是没看见路已经变了。 “ 真正的风险不是 AI 太强太快，而是我们不能继续做当年的养马人。 ” 尹同跃说， “ 未来 AI 真正淘汰的，是拒绝 AI 、不敢用 AI 的企业。 ” 所以奇瑞的选择很直白：刀口向内，主动用 AI 给自己做一场基因重组，先改变自己，再改变世界。 雷峰网认为，判断奇瑞是不是 AI 公司，不能看它发布会上喊了多少次 AI ，要看三件事： AI 有没有重构它的生产流程，有没有沉淀为可复用的统一底座，有没有在汽车之外长出新的物种。 PART 1 从CheryMind到紫微芯片 奇瑞把30年造车经验炼成了AI底座 市面上的通用大模型像一本百科全书，什…

items.summary: 去年和喜欢的小学同桌恢复了联系，闲聊时我提到咱两坐同桌那会发生了什么，她说：“咱两没坐过同桌”，我很诧异，我俩小学四年级可是做了一学期同桌的，怎么会没有呢？ 转念一想，可能我对她并不重要，人们只会记住自己在意的事情，也很正常。 我对关于她的事情记得很清楚，到现在还清晰记得小学某个周末我专程去给她送试卷，她妈妈笑着迎接我，戴的眼镜上挂着一条银色的链子，闪闪发光。 --- 最近和两个女性朋友聊了关于感情的话题，无一例外都说自己将几年前恋爱的事情忘记了，只记得自己分手时很伤心也挽留过，但对面的长相、怎么认识的、甚至连名字都已经模糊不清了，也不是不记得，真的就是忘记了这些事情。 我有点诧异，可能是我记性太好，我对很久之前的事情尤其是爱慕之人相关的事情记得非常清晰，这种刻骨铭心的感觉怎么会忘记呢？到死大概也不会忘。 她们为什么会忘记呢？ 是因为太过痛苦，然后大脑下意识地消除、遮蔽了这方面的记忆，来逃避痛苦吗？

items.summary: 请教各位大佬个事，我现在这算传统行业，目前也算个管理层，在深圳年收入 30 多万，不高不低，但 2 年前新业务线老板过来以后，我已经算被架空了，重要管理层会议基本没我份（由我直接上级参会），目前一亩三分地依然负责不变，但我不用汇报给业务线老板了，每次季度大型会议总是觉得屈辱，自我内耗想跳槽，但实话说，我现在 base 远离业务总部，也就是我现在其实居家办公，远程打个卡报道，日常在家边工作边带娃，工资绩效也不变，算是非常非常舒服的工作，而且跳槽外面行情也一般，说不定跳完以后工作更辛苦工资收入反而拿不到目前水平，有时候想想未来又觉得自己这样边缘化下去浪费时间没有成长，年龄一到估计就拿 N+1 了，也考虑过就这样下去，实在到 N+1 了就去送外卖也可以
